result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **ClickUp for an all-in-one solution, or Linear if you're building a tech or SaaS product.**

The best choice depends on your startup's size, team structure, and how you manage work. You don't want a tool that creates more administrative work than it saves.

## My top 5 project management tools for startups

![ClickUp Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EUZRgWwIwwhuzQ81twW5nPFfsQWQxC8RlsBJDuZXv0Zpm7o99YPqcbXZetIchA1Vn3SPwABHFrIh2WN3WNYdFF7JS8VvplolL4l8keAuLsWtN6Qcp8xcF5K3cYrRRpnMcdoItsdgc5qOq8LxHSRJFEb7dr8UswlYEzPqW6xvVjXj30wNmdoXcPHEuWl3-wZZ?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. ClickUp**

(Best overall all-in-one)

- Tasks, projects, goals, docs, dashboards and automation.
- Highly customizable.
- Good for growing teams across departments.
- Free plan available.

Website: [ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Product Management Logo PNG Vectors Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jMdtdJSnohZ3SVTXki8qf6tahtvwrM-TxQjGIFmV7aBJuQhPDqaUm35V1qU6ww8-pE8f2MJo_usk1jjCs1TXwqwfJpDL-l-F4j2tDVq8AZxfmLYzSB7tEEKnLyMHhVmLz-kGSNyIVnlW8RlOM5GteYxNMgE0N37QOue_5ObJOavqP2Tc9HgIW_m-mWmn3Apf?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product and engineering workflows.
- Issue tracking, roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Fast, clean interface.
- Integrates with GitHub.

Website: [Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Notion Overview 2025: Used By 10 Brands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lP_jCZ1nsJeR_YPX7mdASgxmIcyhTM_2buUZ_9_or78bKjnLgmSwB9ztNO9Cg6RglTpsvYPLYnP-6ZJAyLaiVUmahpdB1kDY6888sX-cbFIDjqWtMaGyugWcdJajYS05viKQWkeLcyUbPl_HESejsBzlnbDbT18G0Ci0sscsnIra_5w11P0ZFww3VGMmFFS9?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Project management and company wiki.
- Meeting notes, documentation and SOPs.
- Product planning and task databases.
- Great for small founding teams.

Website: [Notion](https://notion.so/)

---

![Free High-Quality Asana Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/r9iIVTfZcsugvD24JTkY9PBI2Bo1TJG1dK2BMA6NiR_LJ7O9JXi_zeVmHoHD4B_JffL5ivA7nmLZ43IJ-jv391qnlgTcy55f5JSp7m-uRkKGDw2TaTvxLMw7phsUVmoeY6LZ-0cOb7lgnZRbxYTrDYIjTlPr9aBZrdIwIKL5BGoH7SNib7aeA7IxurDFbwgX?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent for cross-functional teams.
- Clear project ownership and deadlines.
- Good reporting and dependencies.
- Easy for nontechnical employees.

Website: [Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![How to use monday.com: Step by step to create your first board](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nq3Iu8Z2sAydDs9Gaq5pzzFpvXjWFlc5EUhbFoArWh6ls6rqQseZC9vdM9Kyaen55PtqVGOSHLxpGpELfH-dnk5VDGh55TyUJ0X4jheWSIHkKZq95oEOoE0-mIEwHNciQwIIjMcukUpTjRw372iiBQ-jWuus3AGeGSp9AkTFSsYWIyYKw0e3hUGLWpA0evLA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Visual project dashboards.
- Marketing, sales and operations workflows.
- Automation and reporting.
- Good for teams that need visibility across departments.

Website: [Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

## Quick comparison

| Tool | Best use | Starting paid price\* |
|--------|--------|--------|
| ClickUp | All-in-one | \$7/user/mo |
| Linear | Product/engineering | \~\$10/user/mo |
| Notion | Docs + projects | \~\$10/user/mo |
| Asana | Team coordination | \~\$10.99/user/mo |
| Monday.com | Operations | \~\$9/user/mo |


\*Approximate advertised entry prices; billing terms and plan limits vary. Verify current pricing before purchasing.

## What I'd choose at different startup stages

- **Pre-seed (2–5 people)\:** Notion or Trello.
- **Seed stage (5–15 people)\:** ClickUp or Linear.
- **Growing startup (15–50 people)\:** ClickUp or Asana.
- **Scaling startup (50+ people)\:** Asana, Monday.com or Linear alongside dedicated documentation tools.
